passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My grandmother makes cookies in her warm kitchen.
phrases.ko: 나의 할머니는 따뜻한 부엌에서 쿠키를 만들어요.
phrases.zh: 奶奶在温暖的厨房里做饼干。
phrases.py: nǎi nǎi zài wēn nuǎn de chú fáng lǐ zuò bǐng gān。

phrases.en: She likes to knit, and she makes a soft sweater.
phrases.ko: 할머니는 뜨개질을 좋아하고, 부드러운 스웨터를 만들어요.
phrases.zh: 她喜欢织毛衣，会织一件柔软的毛衣。
phrases.py: tā xǐ huān zhī máo yī， huì zhī yī jiàn róu ruǎn de máo yī。

phrases.en: We drink tea together on Sunday.
phrases.py: xīng qī tiān wǒ men yì qǐ hē chá。
tā yǒu shàn liáng de wēi xiào。

phrases.en: The cookies are sweet, and I love them.
phrases.py: bǐng gān hěn tián， wǒ hěn xǐ huān。

phrases.en: She lives on the farm with my grandfather.
phrases.zh: 她和爷爷一起住在农场。
phrases.py: tā hé yé yé yì qǐ zhù zài nóng chǎng。

phrases.en: I visit her because her kitchen feels like home.
phrases.ko: 할머니 부엌은 집처럼 느껴져서 나는 할머니를 보러 가요.
phrases.zh: 我去看望她，因为她的厨房像家一样。
phrases.py: wǒ qù kàn wàng tā， yīn wèi tā de chú fáng xiàng jiā yī yàng。

phrases.en: She knits slowly and talks with me.
phrases.ko: 할머니는 천천히 뜨개질을 하면서 나와 이야기해요.
phrases.zh: 她慢慢地织毛衣，还和我说话。
phrases.py: tā màn màn de zhī máo yī， hái hé wǒ shuō huà。

phrases.en: My little sister sits beside her.
phrases.py: mèi mèi zuò zài tā páng biān。

phrases.en: We smile together when the cookies are ready.
phrases.ko: 쿠키가 준비되면 우리는 함께 미소를 지어요.
phrases.zh: 饼干做好的时候，我们一起微笑。
phrases.py: bǐng gān zuò hǎo de shí hòu， wǒ men yì qǐ wēi xiào。

phrases.en: I love my grandmother very much.
phrases.py: wǒ fēi cháng ài nǎi nǎi。

full_passage_spoken: My grandmother makes cookies in her warm kitchen. She likes to knit, and she makes a soft sweater. We drink tea together on Sunday. She has a kind smile. The cookies are sweet, and I love them. She lives on the farm with my grandfather. I visit her because her kitchen feels like home. She knits slowly and talks with me. My little sister sits beside her. We smile together when the cookies are ready. I love my grandmother very much.
full_passage_zh: 奶奶在温暖的厨房里做饼干。她喜欢织毛衣，会织一件柔软的毛衣。星期天我们一起喝茶。她有善良的微笑。饼干很甜，我很喜欢。她和爷爷一起住在农场。我去看望她，因为她的厨房像家一样。她慢慢地织毛衣，还和我说话。妹妹坐在她旁边。饼干做好的时候，我们一起微笑。我非常爱奶奶。
